seo.title: Thurstan - Old English Name with Christian Connection
seo.meta_description: Derived from Old English ‘Þorstan’, meaning ‘Thor’s stone’ or ‘Thor’s steadfast man’. This name has a rich history rooted in Norse mythology and early English Christianity.
seo.description_paragraph: Thurstan is a traditional Old English name with a strong connection to Christianity. Derived from the Old English words ‘Þor’ (Thor) and ‘stan’ (stone), the name Thurstan means ‘Thor’s stone’ or ‘Thor’s steadfast man’. Thor was the Norse god of thunder, strength, and protection, and was revered by the Anglo-Saxons, Normans, and early English Christians. Thurstan was a popular name among these cultures, and its appeal lies in its rich history and association with strength and protection.
